# P&N Electrical Services

P&N Electrical Services is a local electrical contractor based on the Wirral, Merseyside, operated by Tom, a qualified electrician.

## Services

- EICR (Electrical Installation Condition Report) testing — from £95 for a 1-bedroom property to £150 for a 6-bedroom property, certificate issued same day
- Outdoor and security lighting installation
- Full and partial rewiring
- Consumer unit upgrades
- Fault finding and electrical repairs
- EV charger installation
- Additional sockets and circuits
- Landlord electrical compliance certificates

## Service Area

Wirral, Merseyside — including Wallasey (CH44, CH45), Birkenhead (CH41, CH42, CH43), West Kirby (CH48), Heswall (CH60), Hoylake (CH47), Meols (CH47), New Brighton, Prenton, Oxton, and surrounding areas.

## EICR Pricing

1 bedroom: £95 | 2 bedroom: £115 | 3 bedroom: £120 | 4 bedroom: £130 | 5 bedroom: £140 | 6 bedroom: £150

All prices fixed. No hidden extras. Certificate issued on the same day as the inspection.

## Landlord Compliance

Since 1 April 2021, all landlords in England are legally required to hold a valid EICR for each rental property, renewed at least every 5 years. Non-compliance can result in a civil penalty of up to £30,000. P&N Electrical Services provides landlord EICRs and issues the certificate on the day of the test.
